About us

We are a young company focused on tourism all over Morocco. We were born between the dunes of Erg Chebbi in Merzouga, and we know this country very well: we were born here and have spent many years working in tourism. Showing our country to travellers is our passion.

We do more than show the wonders of our world. Contact with travellers like you, and having lived in other European countries, has taught us several languages: Spanish, English, French, German and a little Catalan. This makes it easier for us to explain the culture and diversity of our country, as well as different ways of thinking and of understanding life.
